lookback_summary: Well, well, well, what a weekend it was! The model nailed the prediction for Fulham vs Man United, calling that draw spot on, while it had to eat humble pie regarding Leeds vs Crystal Palace, which ended up level despite thinking Leeds would take it. On the flip side, the prediction for Man City vs Sunderland was a win, and it was a thrilling one at that. The model also called Bournemouth vs Liverpool and Nott'm Forest vs Coventry City correctly, but it stumbled with Everton vs Ipswich, which turned out to be a surprise home win. Newcastle delivered as expected, but Brighton and Tottenham left the model scratching its head with unexpected home wins. What a rollercoaster!
